app.title: Palikka
app.tagline: A frosty square game in your browser – against friends or the forest animals

crash.body: The game ran into an unexpected error. Reload the page to continue.

settings.title: Settings
settings.soundsNote: A short sound when your turn begins.
settings.turnTitleNote: While the game is in the background, the tab title says your turn has begun.
settings.vibrationNote: A short vibration when your turn begins.
settings.deviceOnly: Settings are saved on this device only.

goal.title: Goal
goal.body: Claim more squares on the board than the others. Everyone gets five turns, and whoever claims the most wins. (This is a temporary practice game: the real pieces and rules are coming soon.)

turn.title: A turn
turn.body: Tap an empty square: it turns your colour and the turn passes on. Hint shows the square the bot would pick.

daily.title: Daily puzzle
daily.body: One solo game a day, the same for everyone: claim the marked squares in as few turns as possible. You see the best possible result, and there is no time limit.
daily.more: You can undo moves and try again. Your best attempt counts as the day's result.
